biography.plain_text: Dogukan Boyaci is a Turkish executive in the family behind Pruva Yachts, the Bodrum yacht builder and charter business. His father established the yard after working in electrical transformers. The family subsequently sold its transformer factory, making yacht construction and chartering its main business, and Boyaci served as vice president.

long_biography.plain_text:
At Pruva Yachts, Dogukan Boyaci saw customers increasingly turn to charter holidays after the global financial crisis. The company built boats for its own charter division, putting them into service before considering a sale. This linked construction to an operating fleet instead of depending solely on individual buyers.

The company attracted a wider international clientele, with customers arriving from Latin America and Asia alongside established American and European markets. Pruva offers holidays in Turkey, Greece and Croatia, arranging itineraries and onboard preferences from its Bodrum base. Its work spans traditional gulets and motor yachts, combining boatbuilding experience with the practical organisation of a holiday at sea.
